Name: True to Figure HD Female Portraits
Author: tted86
Description:
Just like, True to Original HD Female Portraits, you extract the contents to Portraiture\Portraits.  You require Portraiture.  You load the game, interact with the female characters, cycle through the portraits until you have you land on the HD one is both both clearly HD and deeper in color.  Then you lock it in.  That's it.  Please note some pictures are a little blurry, but I fixed those without re-uploading the pics.
